name: battery_charger
claim_text: 1. A charging device comprising: a charging circuit configured to supply current to a battery; a temperature sensor configured to detect a battery temperature; and a controller configured to reduce the current when the battery temperature exceeds a threshold.

prior_art_texts.title: Temperature-aware charger
prior_art_texts.abstract: A battery charger monitors battery temperature and changes charge current.
prior_art_texts.description: [0010] A charging circuit supplies current to a rechargeable battery. [0011] A temperature sensor detects a battery temperature. [0012] A controller reduces the charging current when the temperature exceeds a preset threshold.

prior_art_texts.title: Basic current supply
prior_art_texts.abstract: A charging circuit supplies current to a load.
prior_art_texts.description: [0020] The circuit provides a constant current without temperature feedback.
